description: Developer offers and developer availability statements. Append-only: a newer record lists the ids it supersedes; nothing is deleted. Only approved, current, unblocked records can price a home for a buyer. See docs/PRICING-EVIDENCE.md.

home.label: 1 to 4 BDR (page also lists 2, 3 and 4 bedroom penthouses)

availability.statement: Page shows a project status of "Available"; that is not unit availability.

records.notes: issuedOn is the page's last-modified date in its metadata. Project-wide starting price: it does not price any bedroom count. No payment plan, handover or unit sizes are stated on the page; the brochure, floor plan and fact sheet PDFs were not reviewed. Plot area 4,771 sq m matches the 4,771.04 sq m on every Vista 3 row in the ADREC export.

records.notes: Full payment within six months is a payment condition: this price cannot show affordability for a buyer who needs a developer payment plan. The ADREC export records Vista 3 homes only as apartments, so there is no recorded penthouse price to compare it with.
